patch.value: GH-970: repeated row contracts consume half of agent read output without a suppression contract

Every read repeats a mostly static row_contract and jq selector in TOON and JSON, consuming 49 to 62 percent of small responses. Add a contract-safe session or invocation mechanism that preserves discoverability while avoiding repeated context spend.

Agents can suppress or reference repeated row contracts without suppressing command results; The setting works consistently for TOON JSON CLI SDK and MCP transports through declared runtime contracts; Contract discovery remains available on demand and session behavior is deterministic and measured by the token-surface gate
pm 2026.8.10 read commands in default TOON and JSON output
Run comments, notes, show, and list on a small workspace and measure the row_contract block as a share of each response.
Static extraction metadata is paid once or explicitly requested while call-specific row shape remains discoverable.
The row_contract is always emitted and accounts for 49 to 62 percent of representative small reads.
Repeated static metadata consumes backlog-sweep context and reduces useful project information available to agents.
